synchronized int readBills() {
    boolean validNumberRead = false;
    int billsNumber = 0;
    this.billsNumberField.setText("");
    while (!validNumberRead) {
        this.billsNumberField.requestFocus();
        try {
            this.wait();
        } catch (java.lang.InterruptedException e) {
        }
        try {
            billsNumber = java.lang.Integer.parseInt(this.billsNumberField.getText());
            if (billsNumber >= 0) {
                validNumberRead = true;
            } else {
                this.getToolkit().beep();
            }
        } catch (java.lang.NumberFormatException e) {
            this.getToolkit().beep();
        }
        if (!validNumberRead) {
            this.billsNumberField.setText("Must be a valid integer >= 0");

}

private synchronized void cancelKeyPressed() {
    switch (this.mode) {
        case simulation.SimKeyboard.IDLE_MODE :
            
            
            
            
            synchronized(this.envelopeAcceptor) {
                this.envelopeAcceptor.notify();
            }
        case simulation.SimKeyboard.PIN_MODE :
        case simulation.SimKeyboard.AMOUNT_MODE :
        case simulation.SimKeyboard.MENU_MODE :
            this.cancelled = true;
            this.notify();
    }
}

void animateInsertion() {
    this.originalBounds = this.getBounds();
    java.awt.Rectangle currentBounds = new java.awt.Rectangle(this.originalBounds.x, this.originalBounds.y, this.originalBounds.width, this.originalBounds.height);
    while ((currentBounds.width > 0) && (currentBounds.height > 0)) {
        this.setBounds(currentBounds.x, currentBounds.y, currentBounds.width, currentBounds.height);
        this.repaint();
        try {
            java.lang.Thread.sleep(100);
        } catch (java.lang.InterruptedException e) {
        }
        currentBounds.height -= 1;
        currentBounds.width = (this.originalBounds.width * currentBounds.height) / this.originalBounds.height;
        currentBounds.x = this.originalBounds.x + ((this.originalBounds.width - currentBounds.width) / 2);
        currentBounds.y = this.originalBounds.y + ((this.originalBounds.height - currentBounds.height) / 2);
    } 
    this.setVisible(false);
}

private banking.Status completeDeposit(banking.Message message, banking.Balances balances) {
    int cardNumber = message.getCard().getNumber();
    int accountNumber = simulation.SimulatedBank.ACCOUNT_NUMBER[cardNumber][message.getToAccount()];
    if (accountNumber == 0) {
        return new simulation.SimulatedBank.Failure("Invalid account type");
    }
    
    banking.Money amount = message.getAmount();
    this.BALANCE[accountNumber].add(amount);
    
    balances.setBalances(this.BALANCE[accountNumber], this.AVAILABLE_BALANCE[accountNumber]);
    return new simulation.SimulatedBank.Success();
}

public java.lang.String toString() {
    java.lang.String result = "";
    switch (this.messageCode) {
        case banking.Message.WITHDRAWAL :
            result += "WITHDRAW";
            break;
        case banking.Message.INITIATE_DEPOSIT :
            result += "INIT_DEP";
            break;
        case banking.Message.COMPLETE_DEPOSIT :
            result += "COMP_DEP";
            break;
        case banking.Message.TRANSFER :
            result += "TRANSFER";
            break;
        case banking.Message.INQUIRY :
            result += "INQUIRY ";
            break;
    }
    result += " CARD# " + this.card.getNumber();
    result += " TRANS# " + this.serialNumber;
    if (this.fromAccount >= 0) {
        result += " FROM  " + this.fromAccount;
    } else {
        result += " NO FROM";
    }
    if (this.toAccount >= 0) {
        result += " TO  " + this.toAccount;
    } else {
        result += " NO TO";
    }
    if (!this.amount.lessEqual(new banking.Money(0))) {
        result += " " + this.amount;
    } else {
        result += " NO AMOUNT";
    }
    return result;
}

private banking.Status transfer(banking.Message message, banking.Balances balances) {
    int cardNumber = message.getCard().getNumber();
    int fromAccountNumber = simulation.SimulatedBank.ACCOUNT_NUMBER[cardNumber][message.getFromAccount()];
    if (fromAccountNumber == 0) {
        return new simulation.SimulatedBank.Failure("Invalid from account type");
    }
    int toAccountNumber = simulation.SimulatedBank.ACCOUNT_NUMBER[cardNumber][message.getToAccount()];
    if (toAccountNumber == 0) {
        return new simulation.SimulatedBank.Failure("Invalid to account type");
    }
    if (fromAccountNumber == toAccountNumber) {
        return new simulation.SimulatedBank.Failure("Can\'t transfer money from\n" + "an account to itself");
    }
    banking.Money amount = message.getAmount();
    if (!amount.lessEqual(this.AVAILABLE_BALANCE[fromAccountNumber])) {
        return new simulation.SimulatedBank.Failure("Insufficient available balance");
    }
    
    this.BALANCE[fromAccountNumber].subtract(amount);
    this.AVAILABLE_BALANCE[fromAccountNumber].subtract(amount);
    this.BALANCE[toAccountNumber].add(amount);
    this.AVAILABLE_BALANCE[toAccountNumber].add(amount);
    
    balances.setBalances(this.BALANCE[toAccountNumber], this.AVAILABLE_BALANCE[toAccountNumber]);
    return new simulation.SimulatedBank.Success();
}

private banking.Status withdrawal(banking.Message message, banking.Balances balances) {
    int cardNumber = message.getCard().getNumber();
    int accountNumber = simulation.SimulatedBank.ACCOUNT_NUMBER[cardNumber][message.getFromAccount()];
    if (accountNumber == 0) {
        return new simulation.SimulatedBank.Failure("Invalid account type");
    }
    banking.Money amount = message.getAmount();
    banking.Money limitRemaining = new banking.Money(simulation.SimulatedBank.DAILY_WITHDRAWAL_LIMIT);
    limitRemaining.subtract(simulation.SimulatedBank.WITHDRAWALS_TODAY[cardNumber]);
    if (!amount.lessEqual(limitRemaining)) {
        return new simulation.SimulatedBank.Failure("Daily withdrawal limit exceeded");
    }
    if (!amount.lessEqual(this.AVAILABLE_BALANCE[accountNumber])) {
        return new simulation.SimulatedBank.Failure("Insufficient available balance");
    }
    
    
    simulation.SimulatedBank.WITHDRAWALS_TODAY[cardNumber].add(amount);
    this.BALANCE[accountNumber].subtract(amount);
    this.AVAILABLE_BALANCE[accountNumber].subtract(amount);
    
    balances.setBalances(this.BALANCE[accountNumber], this.AVAILABLE_BALANCE[accountNumber]);
    return new simulation.SimulatedBank.Success();
}

private synchronized void digitKeyPressed(int digit) {
    switch (this.mode) {
        case simulation.SimKeyboard.IDLE_MODE :
            break;
        case simulation.SimKeyboard.PIN_MODE :
            {
                this.currentInput.append(digit);
                java.lang.StringBuffer echoString = new java.lang.StringBuffer();
                for (int i = 0; i < this.currentInput.length(); i++) {
                    echoString.append('*');
                }
                this.setEcho(echoString.toString());
                break;
            }
        case simulation.SimKeyboard.AMOUNT_MODE :
            {
                this.currentInput.append(digit);
                java.lang.String input = this.currentInput.toString();
                if (input.length() == 1) {
                    this.setEcho("0.0" + input);
                } else if (input.length() == 2) {
                    this.setEcho("0." + input);
                } else {
                    this.setEcho((input.substring(0, input.length() - 2) + ".") + input.substring(input.length() - 2));
                }
                break;
            }
        case simulation.SimKeyboard.MENU_MODE :
            {
                if ((digit > 0) && (digit <= this.maxValue)) {
                    this.currentInput.append(digit);
                    this.notify();
                } else {
                    this.getToolkit().beep();
                }
                break;
            }
    }
}

public banking.Status handleMessage(banking.Message message, banking.Balances balances) {
    int cardNumber = message.getCard().getNumber();
    if ((cardNumber < 1) || (cardNumber > simulation.SimulatedBank.PIN.length)) {
        return new simulation.SimulatedBank.Failure("Invalid card");
    }
    if (message.getPIN() != simulation.SimulatedBank.PIN[cardNumber]) {
        return new simulation.SimulatedBank.InvalidPIN();
    }
    switch (message.getMessageCode()) {
        case banking.Message.WITHDRAWAL :
            return this.withdrawal(message, balances);
        case banking.Message.INITIATE_DEPOSIT :
            return this.initiateDeposit(message);
        case banking.Message.COMPLETE_DEPOSIT :
            return this.completeDeposit(message, balances);
        case banking.Message.TRANSFER :
            return this.transfer(message, balances);
        case banking.Message.INQUIRY :
            return this.inquiry(message, balances);
    }
    
    return null;
}

public synchronized int readMenuChoice(java.lang.String prompt, java.lang.String[] menu) throws atm.physical.CustomerConsole.Cancelled {
    simulation.Simulation.getInstance().clearDisplay();
    simulation.Simulation.getInstance().display(prompt);
    for (int i = 0; i < menu.length; i++) {
        simulation.Simulation.getInstance().display(((i + 1) + ") ") + menu[i]);
    }
    java.lang.String input = simulation.Simulation.getInstance().readInput(simulation.Simulation.MENU_MODE, menu.length);
    simulation.Simulation.getInstance().clearDisplay();
    if (input == null) {
        throw new atm.physical.CustomerConsole.Cancelled();
    } else {
        return java.lang.Integer.parseInt(input) - 1;
    }
}

`getSpecificsFromCustomer()` from the class `atm.transaction.Withdrawal`.

## Method Source Code

protected banking.Message getSpecificsFromCustomer() throws atm.physical.CustomerConsole.Cancelled {
    this.from = this.atm.getCustomerConsole().readMenuChoice("Account to withdraw from", banking.AccountInformation.ACCOUNT_NAMES);
    java.lang.String[] amountOptions = new java.lang.String[]{ "$20", "$40", "$60", "$100", "$200" };
    banking.Money[] amountValues = new banking.Money[]{ new banking.Money(20), new banking.Money(40), new banking.Money(60), new banking.Money(100), new banking.Money(200) };
    java.lang.String amountMessage = "";
    boolean validAmount = false;
    while (!validAmount) {
        this.amount = amountValues[this.atm.getCustomerConsole().readMenuChoice(amountMessage + "Amount of cash to withdraw", amountOptions)];
        validAmount = this.atm.getCashDispenser().checkCashOnHand(this.amount);
        if (!validAmount) {
            amountMessage = "Insufficient cash available\n";
        }
    } 
    return new banking.Message(banking.Message.WITHDRAWAL, this.card, this.pin, this.serialNumber, this.from, -1, this.amount);
}

## Outgoing Dependencies (Invokes)

## Method Source Code

public static Transaction makeTransaction(ATM atm, Session session, banking.Card card, int pin) throws CustomerConsole.Cancelled {
    int choice = atm.getCustomerConsole().readMenuChoice("Please choose transaction type", Transaction.TRANSACTION_TYPES_MENU);
    switch (choice) {
        case 0 :
            return new Withdrawal(atm, session, card, pin);
        case 1 :
            return new Deposit(atm, session, card, pin);
        case 2 :
            return new Transfer(atm, session, card, pin);
        case 3 :
            return new Inquiry(atm, session, card, pin);
        default :
            return null;

    }
}

public banking.Status performInvalidPINExtension() throws atm.physical.CustomerConsole.Cancelled, atm.transaction.Transaction.CardRetained {
    banking.Status status = null;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        this.pin = this.atm.getCustomerConsole().readPIN("PIN was incorrect\nPlease re-enter your PIN\n" + "Then press ENTER");
        this.atm.getCustomerConsole().display("");
        this.message.setPIN(this.pin);
        status = this.atm.getNetworkToBank().sendMessage(this.message, this.balances);
        if (!status.isInvalidPIN()) {
            this.session.setPIN(this.pin);
            return status;
        }
    }
    this.atm.getCardReader().retainCard();
    this.atm.getCustomerConsole().display("Your card has been retained\nPlease contact the bank.");

public boolean performTransaction() throws atm.transaction.Transaction.CardRetained {
    java.lang.String doAnotherMessage = "";
    banking.Status status = null;
    banking.Receipt receipt = null;
    
    while (true) {
        switch (this.state) {
            case atm.transaction.Transaction.GETTING_SPECIFICS_STATE :
                try {
                    this.message = this.getSpecificsFromCustomer();
                    this.atm.getCustomerConsole().display("");
                    this.state = atm.transaction.Transaction.SENDING_TO_BANK_STATE;
                } catch (atm.physical.CustomerConsole.Cancelled e) {
                    doAnotherMessage = "Last transaction was cancelled";
                    this.state = atm.transaction.Transaction.ASKING_DO_ANOTHER_STATE;
                }
                break;
            case atm.transaction.Transaction.SENDING_TO_BANK_STATE :
                status = this.atm.getNetworkToBank().sendMessage(this.message, this.balances);
                if (status.isInvalidPIN()) {
                    this.state = atm.transaction.Transaction.INVALID_PIN_STATE;
                } else if (status.isSuccess()) {
                    this.state = atm.transaction.Transaction.COMPLETING_TRANSACTION_STATE;
                } else {
                    doAnotherMessage = status.getMessage();
                    this.state = atm.transaction.Transaction.ASKING_DO_ANOTHER_STATE;
                }
                break;
            case atm.transaction.Transaction.INVALID_PIN_STATE :
                try {
                    status = this.performInvalidPINExtension();
                    
                    
                    
                    if (status.isSuccess()) {
                        this.state = atm.transaction.Transaction.COMPLETING_TRANSACTION_STATE;
                    } else {
                        doAnotherMessage = status.getMessage();
                        this.state = atm.transaction.Transaction.ASKING_DO_ANOTHER_STATE;
                    }
                } catch (atm.physical.CustomerConsole.Cancelled e) {
                    doAnotherMessage = "Last transaction was cancelled";
                    this.state = atm.transaction.Transaction.ASKING_DO_ANOTHER_STATE;
                }
                break;
            case atm.transaction.Transaction.COMPLETING_TRANSACTION_STATE :
                try {
                    receipt = this.completeTransaction();
                    this.state = atm.transaction.Transaction.PRINTING_RECEIPT_STATE;
                } catch (atm.physical.CustomerConsole.Cancelled e) {
                    doAnotherMessage = "Last transaction was cancelled";
                    this.state = atm.transaction.Transaction.ASKING_DO_ANOTHER_STATE;
                }
                break;
            case atm.transaction.Transaction.PRINTING_RECEIPT_STATE :
                this.atm.getReceiptPrinter().printReceipt(receipt);
                this.state = atm.transaction.Transaction.ASKING_DO_ANOTHER_STATE;
                break;
            case atm.transaction.Transaction.ASKING_DO_ANOTHER_STATE :
                if (doAnotherMessage.length() > 0) {
                    doAnotherMessage += "\n";
                }
                try {
                    java.lang.String[] yesNoMenu = new java.lang.String[]{ "Yes", "No" };
                    boolean doAgain = this.atm.getCustomerConsole().readMenuChoice(doAnotherMessage + "Would you like to do another transaction?", yesNoMenu) == 0;
                    return doAgain;
                } catch (atm.physical.CustomerConsole.Cancelled e) {
                    return false;
                }
        }
    } 
}

public void run() {
    atm.Session currentSession = null;
    while (true) {
        switch (this.state) {
            case atm.ATM.OFF_STATE :
                this.customerConsole.display("Not currently available");
                synchronized(this) {
                    try {
                        this.wait();
                    } catch (java.lang.InterruptedException e) {
                    }
                }
                if (this.switchOn) {
                    this.performStartup();
                    this.state = atm.ATM.IDLE_STATE;
                }
                break;
            case atm.ATM.IDLE_STATE :
                this.customerConsole.display("Please insert your card");
                this.cardInserted = false;
                synchronized(this) {
                    try {
                        this.wait();
                    } catch (java.lang.InterruptedException e) {
                    }
                }
                if (this.cardInserted) {
                    currentSession = new atm.Session(this);
                    this.state = atm.ATM.SERVING_CUSTOMER_STATE;
                } else if (!this.switchOn) {
                    this.performShutdown();
                    this.state = atm.ATM.OFF_STATE;
                }
                break;
            case atm.ATM.SERVING_CUSTOMER_STATE :
                
                
                currentSession.performSession();
                this.state = atm.ATM.IDLE_STATE;
                break;
        }
    } 
}
